text:
maria_s: FYI — I opened a docs PR adding an example that walks through queueing latency vs cost tradeoffs for batching configs. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1234. Need eyes on wording and the Grafana panel link.

alex_k: grabbing it now. do we want to show concrete numbers or keep it illustrative? e.g., max_queue_ms 20, 50, 200 — that might be misinterpreted.

jamal_r: +1 to being careful. for Dedicated customers the economics differ — we should include a short note and an example with higher batch sizes.

liz_s: also call out SLA impact. realtime interactive UI should aim for <30ms queuing at p95, otherwise user experience degrades. Add a small caveat box.

maria_s: good call. current draft has a single table but no caveat box. I'll add one.

alex_k: quick nit: the code snippet uses `max_queue_ms`; in our SDK v4 it's `max_queue_time_ms` in examples. keep API names consistent with snippet.

maria_s: thanks — fixed to `max_queue_time_ms`. snippet now: 

```yaml
batching:
  max_batch_size: 8
  max_queue_time_ms: 50
  preferred_model: open-instruct-7b-quant
```

jamal_r: for Dedicated: 

```yaml
batching:
  max_batch_size: 32
  max_queue_time_ms: 200
  fallback_model: open-instruct-7b-quant
```

jamal_r: and added a short table with estimated cost-per-1M-tokens for each config (ballpark only).

liz_s: can we link to the Grafana panel for the queueing vs latency visualization? current doc points to a private dashboard. maybe point to a public example plus an internal link.

maria_s: added two links: public example https://learn.redwood.ai/queueing-demo and internal Grafana https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abc123/queueing-latency (internal only). noted both.

alex_k: CI flagged a linter issue on the YAML formatting. pushed a tiny fix.

docs-bot: CI check passed for docs PR #1234 — 3 checks, 0 failures.

maria_s: updated wording to avoid prescriptive numbers for general customers and added an explicit "For Dedicated customers" section. PTAL.

liz_s: approved. left one very small wording tweak.

jamal_r: reviewed +1. maybe add a short note about quantization effects on throughput.

maria_s: added a 2-line note about quantization and linked to Optimize guide.

alex_k: looks fine to me, approving.

maria_s: thanks everyone :tada: merging once small lint job finishes. will follow up to create the public Grafana snapshot for the learn page.

docs-bot: docs PR #1234 merged (maria_s).
